# Slid Phi Labs — llms.txt
# Primary host: https://www.slidphilabs.com

> Tools that check. Signed agent names, byte-identical programs across 53 targets,
> chapter-by-chapter learning, metered usage behind one Rider credential.

## Products
- [Agent Rider](https://agentrider.fly.dev): signed agent names, Warrant permissions, receipts. Register POST /api/agents, issue POST /api/rider/issue, verify POST /api/rider/verify.
- [CuNi / CuNIverse](https://cuni-studio.fly.dev/): one program, 53 targets, byte-identical stdout or refuse. Tap install.
- [TeachAid](https://teachaid.fly.dev): chapter-by-chapter text and voice learning.
- Hosted suite + PCC: metered jobs. Free allowance: TBD.
- spl-acn client: claim-token access to https://www.slidphilabs.com/api/mcp
- GitDepot: team blob storage.

## Usage
- [Pricing is usage](https://www.slidphilabs.com/pricing-usage): metered usage, not seats. Free allowance: TBD.
- Gating: Rider JWT (ES256, 15-minute TTL) sent as X-Agent-Rider. Refusals carry {error, issue_url, docs_url}.
